text:
ana: Quick, totally scientific poll 🍰 — which editor pairs best with your go-to office dessert?
Options:
A) Vim — dark chocolate cake
B) VS Code — lemon tart
C) Emacs — tiramisu
D) Other (specify)

noah: A) all the way. Dark chocolate vibes = focus :muscle:

priya: B) lemon tart for me. Bright, fast, like my dev feedback loop :zap:

kai: C) Emacs + tiramisu is peak vintage energy. also respect for keyboard macros :keyboard:

marie: D) Sublime + croissant? but if I must pick, B) because lemon keeps me from dozing off after lunch :coffee:

samir: A) but I only eat cake if it's not a meeting day :grimacing:

ana: putting a quick tally — A:2, B:2, C:1, D:1

dev-bot: Poll closed automatically after 10m — results saved to #random-polls-archive

noah: also, can we get a real pastry run? will trade VS Code tips for lemon tart reconnaissance :eyes:

priya: @noah pact accepted. I bring the tart, you bring a VS Code quick key that changes my life :pray:

kai: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/coffee-code-42

marie: note: if someone brings tiramisu, I will teach them one Emacs command per slice :smile:

samir: final thought: editor choice probably correlates with dessert confidence levels. data science when? :chart_with_upwards_trend:

ana: thanks all — delightfully important research. archived — feel free to add more options in thread if you switched snacks :chips:
